status: experimental deployment architecture; not production support claim

profiles.description: One owner-controlled device hosts UI, local trust plane, runtime, and encrypted state with logical separation.
limits: device loss requires external backup/recovery if continuity is desired

profiles.description: Multiple admitted local nodes coordinate over a trusted local network with no Internet dependency.
limits: external revocation/currentness unavailable until reconciliation unless locally mirrored

profiles.description: Nodes operate autonomously during partitions and reconcile bounded state when links return.
limits: operations requiring fresh external authority must remain pending or denied while disconnected

profiles.description: Local nodes retain authority/state while optional managed services provide compute, relay, verification, backup, or interoperability.
limits: managed outage must not cause silent downgrade of local policy

profiles.description: Institution-operated multi-node deployment with local identity, policy, audit, and optional external federation gateways.
limits: federation evidence does not create automatic local trust

profiles.description: No routable external connectivity; artifacts and evidence cross boundaries only through explicit controlled transfer.
limits: external currentness, revocation, and transparency dependencies require staged mirrors or explicit stale-state handling

universal_rules: every topology declares what can continue during disconnection
every topology declares which claims require fresh external verification
reconnection performs explicit reconciliation rather than treating remote state as automatically authoritative
offline execution still produces local evidence and receipts
deployment topology does not change underlying capability authority semantics
